builds.title: Cayma culvert scout, Thief 1 (Scout)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
traits: Neutral good. HP 4 on 1d6. Wears cloth, with a −3 Dexterity adjustment from AC 10.

Unarmored thief scores are Pick Pockets 15%, Open Locks 30%, Find/Remove Traps 10%, Move Silently 60%, Hide in Shadows 50%, Detect Noise 25%, Climb Walls 70% and Read Languages 0%. In wilderness add 10 points each to Move Silently and Hide in Shadows. In towns subtract 5 points from all thief skills. Opponents take −1 to surprise rolls.
Saving throws are 13 paralysis/poison/death magic, 14 rod/staff/wand, 12 petrification/polymorph, 16 breath weapon and 15 spell.
actions: Sling with stone, effective THAC0 18 at short range and 1d4 damage. Range bands 40/80/160 yards outdoors or feet indoors. Apply −2 attack at medium range and −5 at long range.
Dagger, melee THAC0 20, 1d4 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d3 vs. Large targets. Backstab from behind against an unaware target with discernible anatomy, +4 to hit and double weapon damage.
builds.tactics: Tess scouts ahead through the culvert and uses the sling only when a noise will draw the watch away from the exit.

builds.title: Ee’aar ridge messenger, Fighter 1 (Wilderness Warrior)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Infravision 60 ft. Resolves daytime detail over a mile away.
traits: Neutral good. HP 8 on 1d10. No armor or shield and −3 Dexterity to AC. Wings are AC 6 and use the species profile’s hit rules.

At 90 lb., flight is class B through 45 lb. of carried gear and C through 90 lb. Make a Constitution check each hour, target 13 before the profile’s load, wind and altitude adjustments. At 4 HP remaining, glide only. At 2 HP remaining, lose gliding.
Resists sleep and charm spells 30% of the time. Her wings and daily Wisdom checks for confinement follow the player profile.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Shortsword, effective THAC0 19 from the species bonus. Deals 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets and 1d8 vs. Large targets.
Signal with chest light. Turn the light on, off or pulse it at will. Use a rehearsed pulse to identify the next safe landing.
builds.tactics: Ilyra lands in the open to relay the dispatch and blinks a warning before flying on.

builds.title: Enduk short-haul escort, Fighter 1 (Defender)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Distinguishes daytime detail up to half a mile away.
traits: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Height 6 ft. 8 in. and weight 243 lb. Leather improves natural AC 6 to AC 5. Proficient with the footman’s mace.

Can fly in class C with up to 243 lb. of load or D up to 486 lb. Apply the campaign’s normal encumbrance rules as well. Check Constitution 16 each turn after the third. At 5 HP remaining only gliding is possible. At 2 HP remaining both flight and gliding are lost. Apply the sourcebook’s wing-fire rule.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with its faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Footman’s mace, effective THAC0 19, 1d6+2 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d6+1 vs. Large targets.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction, per the Defender kit and the core paladin procedure.
builds.tactics: Sarruk carries supplies across the gap, lands before the fourth turn and holds the ledge until the rest of the party crosses.

builds.title: Gurrash channel guard, Fighter 1 (Savage Warrior)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Normal vision. Once-daily alarm within 10 ft.
traits: Neutral. HP 8 on 1d10 + 3 Constitution. Carries two stone-tipped spears. The harness leaves natural AC 5 intact. The Savage Warrior penalties apply to unfamiliar clothing and armor.

If frustrated, confused or hit for at least 8 damage at once, make a Wisdom check at −2, target 10. Failure grants +1 attack, +3 damage and +5 temporary HP and prevents using a shield or checking morale. It lasts up to five rounds. Magic can end either form. Removing the frustration can end a frustration rage. Killing the attacker can end rage from a wound.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Stone-tipped spear, effective THAC0 21 in melee, 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8 vs. Large targets. Rage changes those numbers to THAC0 20 and 1d6+3 or 1d8+3. On each hit, the tip breaks on a separate roll of 1 on 1d20.

Throw stone-tipped spear, effective THAC0 20 at short range and 1d6 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8 vs. Large targets. Range bands are 10/20/30 yards outdoors or feet indoors, with −2 and −5 attack past short range. In rage, use THAC0 19 at short range and 1d6+3 or 1d8+3. Check for a broken tip on a hit.

Intrusion alarm once per day. Automatically detects a creature at least the size of a rat within 10 feet, including an invisible or incorporeal intruder, with astral and ethereal creatures excepted. The alarm can wake Vorr. To activate it while awake, concentrate without interruption for a round.
builds.tactics: Vorr posts at the shallow crossing and braces against the first creature to charge through the reeds.

builds.title: Um-Shedu threshold guard, Fighter 1 (Defender)
builds.difficulty: Level 1 classed NPC. Base THAC0 20 and one attack per round.
builds.senses: Infravision 60 ft. Range taken from the setting’s companion appendix.
traits: Lawful good Defender of Idu. HP 8 on 1d10 + 2 Constitution. Wears a cloth sash, with natural AC 7. Effective Charisma is 9 with other humanoids and 6 with demihumans or humans.
The Um-Shedu profile is free of the sunlight curse. Immune to manscorpion venom and +2 on saves against all other poison, giving a poison save of 12.
Recognized by Idu’s order. Reaction rolls are 3 better with the faithful and 3 worse with those hostile to the faith. Displays Idu’s symbol, obeys senior clergy and tithes one tenth.
Saving throws are 14 paralysis/poison/death magic, 16 rod/staff/wand, 15 petrification/polymorph, 17 breath weapon and 17 spell.
actions: Spear, effective THAC0 20 in melee, 1d6+1 vs. Small or Medium targets or 1d8+1 vs. Large targets.

Tail sting, effective THAC0 20, reach 10 ft. and 1d4+1 piercing damage as an encounter ruling. Choose this or the spear for the round. A failed unmodified save vs. poison causes one woozy round followed by 2d8 rounds of sleep. Neutralize poison ends the sleep early.
Detect evil intent. Concentrate for one round to detect evil intent up to 60 feet in the chosen direction.
builds.tactics: Tamar keeps enough space behind the gate to raise the tail, then leaves the spears lowered if the intruder surrenders.

concepts.name: Tess Reedknot
concepts.motive: Reopen a blocked side channel before floodwater reaches the pens.
concepts.hook: Tess finds a torn rope down in the sluice and asks who cut it while the current was low.

concepts.name: Ilyra Serein
concepts.motive: Deliver a warning before the mountain winds turn.
concepts.hook: Ilyra can fly the dispatch to the next ridge, but asks the party to retrieve the lantern marking her landing site.

concepts.name: Sarruk Reedhorn
concepts.role: Short-haul escort and Defender of Idu
concepts.motive: Bring an injured traveler over the ravine.
concepts.hook: Sarruk asks for a guide rope across the last ledge before lifting his passenger.

concepts.name: Vorr Deepwake
concepts.motive: Keep strangers from blundering into the deep current or disturbing the fish traps.
concepts.hook: Vorr gestures to a stake below the waterline and offers safe crossing in exchange for a warning if an unfamiliar boat appears.

concepts.name: Tamar of Um-Shedu
concepts.motive: Account for everyone sheltering behind the gate before dusk.
concepts.hook: Tamar’s gate ledger has one more name than the people inside. The signature is still wet.
